name: Fail2ban Guard
description: Real-time intrusion detection and automatic IP banning for Nginx — blocks path scanners, sensitive path probes, brute-force attacks, and malicious bots with custom rules, whitelist protection, and auto-expiry.
author: Rustry

permission_reasons.log.read: Stream Nginx access logs in real time to detect 404 scanning, sensitive path probing, brute-force attacks, and malicious bots.
permission_reasons.nginx.snippet: Write and maintain debounced Nginx deny snippets to block detected malicious IPs and automatically remove expired bans.
permission_reasons.kv: Persist lightweight global plugin settings, debounce tuning, and whitelist metadata in the isolated plugin KV store.
permission_reasons.notify: Send warning and error alerts to the Nginx UI notification center on mass ban waves or Nginx snippet reload failures.
permission_reasons.sites.read: List managed Nginx sites to map access log paths to sites and provide guided snippet include instructions.

zh_CN.name: Fail2ban 防护
zh_CN.description: 实时监控 Nginx 访问日志，自动识别并封禁路径扫描、敏感探测、暴力破解与恶意爬虫 IP，支持自定义规则、白名单防误封与到期自动解封。

permission_reasons.log.read: 实时接收 Nginx 访问日志流，用于检测 404 路径扫描、敏感路径探测、认证爆破与恶意扫描器。
permission_reasons.nginx.snippet: 通过防抖合并写入 Nginx deny 配置片段以执行 IP 封禁，并在到期后自动解封。
permission_reasons.kv: 在插件隔离 KV 存储中持久化全局开关、防抖参数与白名单摘要配置。
permission_reasons.notify: 发生大规模封禁波动或 Nginx 重载失败时，向 Nginx UI 通知中心发送脱敏告警。
permission_reasons.sites.read: 读取已托管站点列表以关联访问日志路径，并生成配置片段引入引导。
